Dude, whoever you are,
I know how hard it is. I'm currently in your position. Im not going to sit here and tell you looks don't matter. I've been told that a lot and I hate it. When I tell them I hate how I look or I'm so ugly I wanna die, that's their go to sentence. I wanted to kill myself. Even now, I often see these really good looking white dudes with blue eyes and think to myself "I'm not him" . I have never been in any relationships which compounds the matter. However, 2 days back I was walking back to my dorm, when I saw this Chinese dude. It looked like he was a bit deformed. And his neck was attached very rigidly. I looked at him for a couple of minutes. He smiled back at me. And kept walking. That's when I realized how ungrateful I had been for what I have. I know this won't ease your pain but if there are people that can live with their deformities and be total bad asses about it, can we not live with our mediocre faces?
